text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's independent weekly newspapers.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A hearing of South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission is expected to reveal details of a South African Defence Force raid into Botswana on June 14, 1985. Thirteen people were killed when a house, allegedly used by the African National Congess, was attacked by then senior South African police superintendent Vic McPherson and others. McPherson is applying to the TRC for amnesty.

- The HIV virus prevalent in Botswana has been found to be mutating faster than any other, Minister of Health Chapson Butale told parliament. It was a distinct subset of HIV1 type C, the type found in most other parts of southern Africa and India.
- Barclays Bank of Botswana public relations officer Mike Klinck (32) and his brother Sonny (26) have been charged with possession of marijuana. It is alleged they cultivated 225 grams of the drug.
